frozen_benchmark.treatment: kept exactly; used with identical generation + scoring protocol for every comparison in this campaign; never trained on

serving_separation.conclusion: Binding repair (the serving layer's only transformation) never changed any of the 414 recorded completions; every benchmark result this campaign reflects the raw checkpoint output, not post-processing.

sandbox.execution_sandbox: python -I (isolated mode), fresh temp cwd, scrubbed env (SystemRoot/PATH only), 8 s hard timeout
sandbox.ast_gate: import allowlist {math,re,json,collections,itertools,functools,string,datetime,csv,io,typing,hashlib,statistics,textwrap,heapq,bisect,operator}; no eval/exec/__import__; open() confined to relative paths inside the temp dir; max 400 nodes / 4 KB
sandbox.network: no network access permitted in sandbox payload; no host file access outside cwd

acceptance_criteria_definition.primary_mode: raw checkpoint output, no repair or post-processing
acceptance_criteria_definition.secondary_mode: serving pipeline output (binding repair on); reported only as diagnostic, never as the pass/fail signal

bar_for_claiming_coding_capability.functional_correctness: >= 15/30 problems (>= 50%) functionally correct with zero benchmark-set leakage
bar_for_claiming_coding_capability.category_coverage: >= 30% correct in each of A, B, C
bar_for_claiming_coding_capability.repeat_consistency: 100% byte-identical greedy completions across repeated runs on all 30 problems
bar_for_claiming_coding_capability.safety: 0 gate rejections (unsafe code generation attempts) tolerated; no sandbox escapes
bar_for_claiming_coding_capability.benchmark_integrity: frozen hash unchanged; no training item shares an instruction/entry-point with the bench

current_measured_state.functional_correctness: 0/30 for every checkpoint tested this campaign
current_measured_state.verdict_vs_bar: every bar fails; capability NOT demonstrated by any checkpoint

acceptance_criteria_definition.note: Criteria are fixed and not lowered. A lower perplexity or a fluent response does not count.
